menden-app/src/main/resources/application.properties
menden-app/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties
===
--- menden-app/src/main/resources/application.properties ---
spring.flyway.enabled=true
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate
spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate=true
spring.flyway.locations=classpath:/db/migration

spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/urbo
spring.datasource.username=postgres
spring.datasource.password=postgres

management.server.port=8081
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus
management.endpoints.web.base-path=/

app.cors.urls=http://localhost:4200

spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri=http://localhost:8090/realms/swcode
app.keycloak.clientId=urbo-api

keycloak.management.url=http://localhost:8090
keycloak.management.realm=swcode
keycloak.management.client-id=urbo-api
keycloak.management.client-secret=**********
keycloak.management.cms-role-client-id=urbo-frontend

admin.user.creation-enabled=true
admin.user.email=test@test.de
admin.user.first-name=Admin
admin.user.last-name=User

swcode.queue.commandBasePackage=io.swcode
queue.retry.maxAttempts=3

menden.scheduler.lock.default-locked-at-most-for=5m

menden.scheduler.events.enabled=true
menden.scheduler.events.fixed-rate=PT30M
menden.scheduler.events.lock.at-most=28m
menden.scheduler.events.lock.at-least=28m

# Feed rank of an event = exclusivity-rank + max-boost * exp(-daysUntilItsDate / decay-days).
# exclusivity-rank: base rank of every event, relative to experiences' 0..10 exclusivityRank.
# max-boost: how high an imminent event's date-proximity boost can climb above that base.
# decay-days: how many days it takes for that boost to fade as the date recedes.
feed.event.exclusivity-rank=0
feed.event.max-boost=12.0
feed.event.decay-days=20.0

arcgis.url=https://geo.menden.de/hosting/services/Sonstiges/POI_Menden/MapServer/WFSServer
destination.one.url=http://localhost:3000/
destination.one.auth.token=test

mec.token=token

swcode.meilisearch.url=http://localhost:7700
swcode.meilisearch.apiKey=masterKey
swcode.meilisearch.tenantIdentifier=tenantA123

aws.s3.bucketName=test-bucket
aws.s3.region=us-west-2
aws.s3.endpoint=http://127.0.0.1:4566
aws.s3.accessKey=YOUR_ACCESS_KEY
aws.s3.secretKey=YOUR_SECRET_KEY

imgproxy.url=http://localhost:8082
imgproxy.key=e4b9d1f5a2c3e6f7d8b0a9c1e3d5f7a2
imgproxy.salt=1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d

urbo.scheduler.lock.default-locked-at-most-for=5m
urbo.scheduler.node.red.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.poi.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.parking.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.waste-collection.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.news.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.event.enabled=false
urbo.scheduler.citizen-service.enabled=false

spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size=10MB
spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size=10MB

urbo.notification.sendinblue.apiKey=""
urbo.notification.sendinblue.senderEmail=info@swcode.io
urbo.notification.sendinblue.senderName=SWCode

urbo.notification.subscription.apiBaseUrl=${app.api.baseUrl}

app.api.baseUrl=http://localhost:8080

urbo.tenant.name=menden

casbin.tenant-migration.enabled=true
urbo.legacy-role-migration.enabled=true
--- menden-app/src/main/resources/application-prod.properties ---
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:postgresql://psql-swcode-1.database.svc.cluster.local:5432/menden
spring.datasource.username=${DB_USERNAME}
spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD}

app.cors.urls=https://erlebnis.menden.de,https://erlebnis-cms.menden.de,https://www.erlebnis-cms.menden.de,https://www.erlebnis.menden.de

spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri=https://auth.swcode.io/auth/realms/menden
app.keycloak.clientId=menden-api

keycloak.management.url=https://auth.swcode.io/auth
keycloak.management.realm=menden
keycloak.management.client-id=${KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_CLIENT_ID}
keycloak.management.client-secret=${KEYCLOAK_MANAGEMENT_CLIENT_SECRET}
keycloak.management.cms-role-client-id=${KEYCLOAK_CMS_ROLE_CLIENT_ID:menden-cms-app}

arcgis.url=https://geo.menden.de/hosting/services/Sonstiges/POI_Menden/MapServer/WFSServer
destination.one.url=https://meta.et4.de/rest.ashx/search/
destination.one.auth.token=${DESTINATION_ONE_AUTH_TOKEN}

mec.token=${MEC_TOKEN}

admin.user.creation-enabled=false
admin.user.email=developers@swcode.io
admin.user.first-name=Admin
admin.user.last-name=User

swcode.meilisearch.url=http://urbo-meilisearch.urbo.svc.cluster.local:7700
swcode.meilisearch.apiKey=${MEILISEARCH_API_KEY}
swcode.meilisearch.tenantIdentifier=${MEILISEARCH_TENANT_IDENTIFIER}

aws.s3.bucketName=urbo-menden-cms-prod
aws.s3.endpoint=https://obs.eu-de.otc.t-systems.com
aws.s3.accessKey=${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
aws.s3.secretKey=${S3_SECRET_KEY}
aws.s3.cors.urls=https://erlebnis.menden.de,https://erlebnis-cms.menden.de,https://www.erlebnis-cms.menden.de,https://www.erlebnis.menden.de

imgproxy.url=https://imgproxy.swcode.io
imgproxy.key=${IMGPROXY_KEY}
imgproxy.salt=${IMGPROXY_SALT}

app.api.baseUrl=https://erlebnis-api.menden.de

urbo.notification.subscription.apiBaseUrl=${app.api.baseUrl}

observation.command: cd /workspace/backend && find menden-app/src -name 'application*' | head; echo "==="; for f in $(find menden-app/src/main/resources -name 'application*.y*ml' -o -name 'application*.properties'); do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; done
